name: Liaoning Chengda Biotechnology Co., Ltd.
summary: Liaoning Chengda Biotechnology Co., Ltd., a biopharmaceutical company, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of vaccines in China and internationally. It offers inactivated Japanese encephalitis and SPEEDA-rabies vaccines. The company also develops rabies vaccine which is in new drug approval stage; influenza vaccine which is in new drug application stage; recombinant human papillomavirus 15-valent vaccine which is in Phase II clinical stage; and 13-valent pneumococcal polysaccharide conjugate, varicella, and meningococcal A, C, Y and W-135 conjugate vaccines which are in Phase I clinical stage.
